Education facilities with supplemental info, useful as a schools gap list; the service URL returned an error, so graded from metadata.

Single town boundary polygon; OSM already carries Orangeville's admin boundary, so this is a check only.
239 street segments with restriction type and times from signs; could fill parking:*:restriction tags OSM rarely has.
Older 2024 copy of Parks and Recreation Areas (ca/on/orangeville/parks-and-recreation-areas) with the same 36 parks.
Official names for 36 parks with hours and amenity flags (playground, splash pad, courts); points, so conflate onto OSM park areas.
13 parcel polygons with addresses but no names, last edited 2020; OSM usually has these churches.
1282 segments with official street names, address ranges and route numbers; a reference to check OSM street names against.
7 sites designated under the open-air burning bylaw; a legal designation, the facilities themselves are mapped elsewhere.
168 trail segments with surface, width and permitted uses; most segments carry no name, so the gain is surface and access tags.
94 sharrow markings from 2019; marks streets for cycleway=shared_lane, which OSM often lacks.
